app.name: House Design for Sales
app.disclaimer: Plans and prices here are sales drafts and preliminary checks only — not construction drawings. They must be reviewed and certified by a licensed architect/engineer before real use.

list.title: Project
list.empty: No projects yet — start by creating one

brief.title: Design brief
brief.corners: Plot corners (m) — one point per line, e.g. 0,0 / first edge is the front
brief.areaSqWaHint: Optional — computed from the plot size
brief.freeTextHint: e.g. "Elderly parents, want a ground-floor bedroom, airy house with deep eaves" — AI turns this into requirements in the next step
brief.err_budget_range: Max budget must be at least the min

project.approxSetback: Irregular plot — buildable area is approximate
project.noDesigns: No designs yet — ask the AI above
project.envelopeNote: Red dashed line = buildable area under {j} rules (assuming windows on every side) — preliminary check

ai.hint: The AI designs 3 directions (cost-efficient / balanced / spacious) in parallel; each takes about 1–4 minutes. Plans are checked and auto-corrected by the AI.
ai.missingKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on the server — add it in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables and redeploy
ai.roughNote: Rough estimate from a provisional per-m² rate — real price from the BOQ in a later step
ai.editPlaceholder: e.g. make the living room 1 m wider / move the bathroom next to the master bedroom

editor.title: 2D plan editor
editor.toolHint_select: Click a room to select, drag it to move, drag the middle of a wall to resize (neighbouring rooms follow — hold Alt to resize one room). Drag empty space to pan, scroll to zoom.
editor.toolHint_room: Drag on the plan to draw a new room
editor.toolHint_door: Click a wall to add a door
editor.toolHint_window: Click a wall to add a window
editor.toolHint_sliding_door: Click a wall to add a sliding door
editor.toolHint_opening: Click a wall to add an open passage
editor.editingFrom: Editing version {n} — saving creates a new version
editor.nonRect: Irregular room — can move but not resize
editor.help: Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo · Delete remove · arrows nudge by one grid step · Esc cancel. The floor below is shown dashed on upper floors.

studio.title: Materials & price
studio.samplePrices: Material prices are sample data — replace with the company price list in the price-import step
studio.deltaNote: Difference vs the Standard material of each item

compliance.title: Preliminary building-regulation check
compliance.disclaimer: Preliminary check only — must be certified by a licensed architect/engineer before a permit application

rulesAdmin.title: Building regulations by area
rulesAdmin.intro: All values are defaults for preliminary checks. A licensed architect must review the values and sources, then tick "verified" with their name.
rulesAdmin.verifiedLabel: Values verified by a licensed architect
rulesAdmin.help_opening_to_boundary: heightThresholdM: height that switches the requirement · minUnderM / minOverM: opening distance (m) · blankWallMinM · roadSide: fail | warn | skip
rulesAdmin.help_setback_road_centerline: roadWidthBelowM: applies to roads narrower than this · minFromCenterlineM
rulesAdmin.help_setback_road_fraction: appliesTo: building types · fraction of road width · roadWidthMinM/MaxM · overMaxDistanceM
rulesAdmin.help_height_vs_road: factor: height ≤ factor × distance to the far side of the road
rulesAdmin.help_far_osr: zones: { "ย.3": { "far": 2.5, "osrPercent": 20 } } — from the comprehensive plan in force (null = not checked)
rulesAdmin.newAreaHint: Projects whose province matches the Thai name use this rule set. Rules are copied from the template area, then adjusted for local ordinances.

wf.title: Status & approvals
wf.draftHint: When ready to present the design and price to the customer, press this
wf.needVersion: Choose an AI option or save at least one version first
wf.proposedHint: Enter the discount the customer asked for (if any) — up to {limit}% is approved directly, more needs the sales manager
wf.approvedHint: Design and price approved — quotation/contract can be issued (M9)
wf.restoreConfirm: Create a new version copied from v{n}?

review.title: Design review
review.disclaimer: Sales draft — approvals on this page must be made by a licensed architect/engineer and include the licence number
review.clickHint: Click the plan to pin a comment
review.commentPlaceholder: e.g. this beam span exceeds 6 m, add a column

export.dxfHint: Download all floor plans as DXF in millimetres with separate layers — opens in AutoCAD

doc.areas: Total usable area {total} m² (indoor {indoor} m²) · {bed} bed · {bath} bath · {park} parking
doc.salesDraft: The design in this quotation is a sales draft, not a construction drawing. It must be checked and signed by a licensed architect/engineer before construction.
doc.printHint: Press print and choose "Save as PDF" · A4 · enable "Background graphics"

quotes.title: Quotations / contracts
quotes.hintDraft: Price not approved yet — quotations issued now carry a DRAFT watermark
quotes.hintFinal: Price approved — quotations are issued without a watermark

companyAdmin.title: Company & document settings
companyAdmin.intro: Used on newly issued quotations and contracts (issued documents do not change)
companyAdmin.salesDiscountLimitPct: Discount sales may give without approval (%)
companyAdmin.contract: Contract template (Thai | English) — wording set by your legal team
companyAdmin.note: Issued quotations keep the data from their issue date — issue a new one to use updated settings
companyAdmin.priceIncludesVat: Selling prices include VAT (VAT is extracted from the price)
companyAdmin.notesHint: One note per line — structural standard, piles, warranties, what the price includes/excludes
companyAdmin.specHint: Items linked to a material slot (⇢) are filled with the material the customer chose on the Materials / package page; your text is appended
companyAdmin.resetSpecConfirm: Replace the whole specification with the default?
companyAdmin.specExtraTh: Text after the material name (Thai, optional)
companyAdmin.specExtraEn: Text after the material name (English, optional)

elev.title: Elevations
elev.name: {side} (faces {dir})
elev.note: Outline elevations from the plan — real floor heights and opening sizes, no material detail; the architect adds the detailing
